crossRefs.note: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

translations.web: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.
translations.bsb: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
translations.kjv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
translations.asv: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being double.
